hypothesis: A V16 producer run ID can bind acknowledged samples to the session-bound scorer-event envelope reducer when every owner-side admission, release and semantic binding carries that same session identity.
test: Use the current acknowledged sampler from PR #7545, current-main ProgressClock V2 and current occurrence/session-envelope reducer from PR #7546. Generate a deterministic two-sample positive event using a fake game, enrich the scorer sample/event session identity from the producer run ID, and pass action telemetry with that session identity into the frozen reducer. Test both release source shapes and fail-closed identity/clock/state controls. Also exercise PR #7545's external terminal-update acknowledgment path.

decision.pass: The matched event yields SINGLE_POSSIBLE_INTENT_ENVELOPE for exactly the expected occurrence, retains producer run/sample/update identity, and claims no causation; mismatched or absent session identity is rejected and endpoint ties remain unresolved.
decision.fail: Any cross-session evidence produces an envelope, any unlinked event is accepted, or the result claims a uniquely active key or causal effect.
decision.scope: Synthetic source-composition construction only; not an actual V16 session, source adoption, engine freshness, gameplay or physical-input qualification.
